issues.title: [upstream][dozzle] Update core to v10.7.3
issues.description:
A new stable Dozzle release is available.

Current core version: `v10.7.2`
Latest upstream version: `v10.7.3`
Release: v10.7.3
Published at: 2026-08-19T14:18:40Z
Release URL: https://github.com/amir20/dozzle/releases/tag/v10.7.3

Update the pinned core version in the Docker build configuration, CI configuration and application defaults. Review upstream changes, rebuild the images and run the test suite before publishing a new Dozzle Plus release.
